title: Update PWA splash screen to full-screen background image without logo

requirements.summary: Update the PWA splash screen to display the user-provided background image URL as a full-screen static background, removing any logo overlay entirely
acceptanceCriteria: The splash screen displays only the background image with no logo visible
The background image fills the entire screen
The splash screen uses the static background image URL provided by the user in earlier conversation

file_operations.description: Update the splash screen meta tags to reference the full-screen background image (frontend/public/assets/generated/court-bg.dim_1920x1080.png) for all PWA splash screen configurations. Remove any logo overlay references from splash screen meta tags. Ensure the background image fills the entire viewport without additional branding elements.

Update the PWA manifest to use the full-screen background image (frontend/public/assets/generated/court-bg.dim_1920x1080.png) as the splash screen background. Remove any logo or icon overlays from the splash screen configuration. Ensure theme_color and background_color complement the background image if needed.
